description: Prompt templates used by the agent. Kept as data so prompts can be reviewed and versioned without editing Python.

planner_system.purpose: Turn a task objective into a structured, safe browsing plan.
constraints: Only ever target the single allowed target page given in the user message.
Never invent other pages or external domains.
One step must be action=wait_for_selector with the CSS selector given for this workflow.
stop_conditions must state what halts the run (page not found, selector absent, repeated extraction failures).

completion_system.purpose: Write a concise operational summary from detected business-relevant changes.

output_shape.headline: one sentence, what changed and why it matters
output_shape.recommended_owner: which team should act (Growth, Revenue Management, Merchandising, Strategy)
output_shape.confidence_note: one sentence noting any uncertainty or low-confidence data

escalation_rules: Mark requires_human_review true when price/discount movement exceeds 15%.
Mark requires_human_review true when any extracted row had low confidence.
Mark requires_human_review true when the change is ambiguous or the source is unfamiliar.

fallback_policy.description: If no LLM provider is configured or the call fails, both stages fall back to deterministic logic so the pipeline always completes.
fallback_policy.planner_fallback: Emit a fixed navigate -> wait_for_selector -> extract plan using the workflow's known selector.
fallback_policy.completion_fallback: List each business-relevant change as 'entity: change_type (previous -> current)' and flag review if any row was low-confidence.
